Definition: Avvith (or Avvoth), a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Avith was the city of Hadad, the Edomite king who defeated Midian in the field of Moab, named in the old Edomite king-list of Genesis and repeated word for word in Chronicles. The name appears only here, as a royal city of Edom before Israel had a king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the old king-lists matter because they show God was already at work among the nations, keeping records of kings and cities long before Israel's story began.
